drawings.description: un dessin : deux cônes opposés par leur base, la base étant un disque hachuré — la suspension au sens usuel ; à côté, son avatar combinatoire, un losange de quatre sommets, légendé $(X,e)$ avec une flèche vers $e$
drawings.kind: suspension: two cones on a hatched disc; rhombus (X, e)
drawings.notes: Two cones opposed by their base, the base a hatched disc (ellipse), the upper apex joined by a vertical stroke to a point of the base, a dotted stroke to the lower apex; beside it the combinatorial avatar, a rhombus of four vertices with a heavy dot at the left vertex, labelled (X, e) with an arrow to e.

drawings.kind: sheet of sketches: X x Y, diamond X0..X3, X -> X x I, long pencil curves
drawings.notes: Redrawn on a tight crop. The rest of the sheet: X x Y with an arrow down-left; the diamond X_0, X_1, X_2, X_3 (X_0 -> X_1, X_1 -> X_3, X_2 -> X_3, and a stroke from X_2 towards X_0 with no head); X -> X x I and x_0 x I; the long pencil curves crossing the sheet: one at the left in two pieces (broken at the label X x Y), one through the middle passing beside the diamond, one at the right. The arrows are separate strokes between the labels, as on the page (no vertex is drawn). Left out: the scribbled, struck "x_0, y" near the middle. The cones, the rhombus and (X, e) belong to 04-1; the "Sigma^1 X" written above the cones (the suspension the cones depict) is drawn in neither record: to check whether it belongs to 04-1.
